description: Course Description: This course serves both to introduce public health as a concept, juxtaposing it against personal medicine, and to provide a historical survey of the conceptualization and efforts to implement public health campaigns in the past and present. After establishing the concept and chronology of public health, the course will focus on case studies from different parts of the US and world, highlighting how ideas about the body, the body politic, and difference can affect the ways by which public health is conceptualized. Prerequisite: PHS 150.
